name: io.github.yarenty/emperor-pdf
title: emperor-pdf
description: Read, search and render the PDFs in one folder; merge, extract and create them from Markdown.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: The only folder the server can see; tool paths are relative to it.

packageArguments.name: --pdfium-dir
packageArguments.description: Folder holding the PDFium library (scripts/fetch-pdfium.sh); without it text falls back to lopdf and rendering is off.
Offer pdf_pages and pdf_create and allow saving rendered pages inside the root folder.

environmentVariables.name: PDF_WRITABLE
environmentVariables.description: Same as --writable: true, 1 or yes offers pdf_pages and pdf_create and allows saving rendered pages; unset, empty, false, 0 or no keeps the server read-only.
